name: mcp2-write-tools
title: MCP2: n2-mcp write tools with one undo step per call, rolled-back batches, agent sessions with journal/summary/revert, text asset writes with backups, irreversible operations gated, policy flags and budgets
issue: MCP design C:/Method Notes Obsidian/orchestrator/proposals/mcp-engine-design.md (decisions M1-M12 ACCEPTED 2026-10-20): this is PR MCP2. MCP1 (merged, frontend repo mcp/: stdio bridge, --launch and --connect backends, READ tools, schemas golden file, budgets, untrusted-data marking, error mapping, admin refusal, token handling) is the base: read its code and README, then the design sections on write tools, edit semantics (agent sessions, edit groups, undo/revert, journal), irreversible operations M7 (save, project settings, open over unsaved changes, file-restoring revert: require ELICITATION, and when the client lacks it, allow them only if the operator started the bridge with --allow-irreversible, NEVER on a model-supplied confirm flag), budgets M1 (2000 writes per session, 500 ops per batch, 120 calls per minute), M4/M5 (per-agent token user, admin refused unless --allow-admin), 4.5 budgets and the security model FULLY first. Verify the CURRENT MCP spec/SDK elicitation API yourself (the proposal says revision 2026-07-28 uses a multi-round-trip pattern for server-initiated requests while 2025-11-25 clients must keep working: read modelcontextprotocol.io and the pinned SDK) and record findings. SCOPE (WRITE tools only; play tools are MCP3, the Electron backend and yield flag are later): (1) tools with agent-oriented schemas and destructiveHint/readOnlyHint annotations (verify the annotation names for both spec revisions): n2_create_entity, n2_destroy_entity, n2_set_transform, n2_set_parent, n2_rename/set properties, n2_add_component, n2_remove_component, n2_set_component_fields, n2_duplicate_entity, n2_create_scene/open/save (irreversible gate), n2_write_text_asset (create/overwrite text assets incl. Lua scripts: BACKUP of the previous content kept in the session journal/dir, size cap 100 KB, path must be under assets/ and NEVER under <project>/editor/ (the host refuses; also refuse client-side), irreversible-gated when it overwrites), n2_create_script, n2_set_project_settings (irreversible gated; never the determinism block unless the bridge role is admin and allowed), n2_undo/n2_redo (bounded to the agent's own session steps); each call maps to the existing protocol commands with ONE undo step per call (edit group labelled with the tool name), (2) a BATCH tool n2_apply_batch (up to 500 ops, atomic: one edit group, rolled back on the first failure with a clear report of which op failed and nothing applied), (3) AGENT SESSIONS: n2_begin_session/n2_end_session (or implicit per connection) with a JOURNAL of every write (tool, args summary, resulting undo step labels, backups), n2_session_summary (what changed), n2_session_revert (undo the session's steps in reverse; file-restoring revert is irreversible-gated), counters for the 2000-writes budget, (4) policy flags: --read-only (no write tools listed), --allow-irreversible, --allow-admin (existing), --max-writes, and per-tool enable lists; write tools are NOT listed when the host role is viewer or the host is read-only, (5) ERROR mapping for write refusals (forbidden, readOnly, busy/takeover, editGroupOpen, staleUiRevision n/a) to actionable tool errors, host edit result fields (revision, canUndo, label) returned, (6) TESTS (node, against the FAKE host fixtures extended for writes): every tool's happy path and refusals, atomic batch rollback, journal contents and revert, backups, irreversible gating with and without elicitation and with the flag, size/rate/write budgets, editor/ path refusal, role/read-only listing rules, untrusted-data handling in echoed names, token never in outputs, golden tool-schema file updated deliberately, (7) README (MCP section): the write tools, sessions, journal, flags, safety model, config snippets verified from current docs. Run typecheck and tests locally before pushing. Frontend rules: requiresDocs is false (README only); run npm run typecheck and npm test locally before every push; no token in logs/storage; NEVER run taskkill or kill other processes; keep changes inside the files your lane owns (other frontend items are in flight: README.md and keymap/panel registrations will collide mechanically: keep each as a small separate hunk; the repo README is LF); no engine/protocol change unless this item says so. Read the named design sections and the decisions (all ACCEPTED by the user) FIRST. Merged and usable: F1 panel registry/layout, F2 prefs store + keymap, FE3 rotate/scale gizmos (mode on ViewportController, W/E/R/Q keymap actions), FE5 inspector local transform, FE6/FE7 filters, FE8 history panel, MCP1 n2-mcp (mcp/), the protocol 1.14.0 typed client. You may touch mcp/ and the minimum of src/protocol client helpers (no generated file edits).
